desc: Prove that any selected operation-2 set can be represented by at most two intervals determining their maximum left endpoint and minimum right endpoint, including disjoint intersections and distinct operation labels.
Fix candidate generation for two operation-2 intervals plus one operation-1 interval by filtering extrema to intervals capable of intersecting the operation-1 interval.
Prove global minimality after combining zero-, one-, and two-operation-2 cases.
Implement the final subquadratic algorithm within the stated constraints.
Independently verify generated outputs by simulating all operations and checking feasibility, cost, and optimality against exhaustive brute force.
Resolve the reported Sample 1 test verdict, correcting the implementation only if the generated output is genuinely invalid or non-minimal.
